capabilities.name: Keep double-entry books where every entry balances debit against credit.

built.evidence: The effective `requires` on GLTransaction.post is RuleComplianceGuard::validateTransaction: lib/Settings/register.d/add-shillinq-rule-compliance-guard.json:24 overrides lib/Settings/shillinq_register.json:512 (BalanceGuard::isBalanced) through deepMergeConfig, and validateTransaction delegates the balance check to lib/Lifecycle/BalanceGuard.php:77 isBalanced(), which sums GLLine debit vs credit; several PHP posters write balanced GLTransaction+GLLine directly (lib/Service/FixedAssetDisposalService.php, CogsPosterService.php, PayrollService.php).
